body.zh: 正面 / Edge / 背面 / 形貌与元素
body.en: Front / edge / back / morphology and elements

body.zh: 注：风险点仅示意，分布不具备固定性；需结合步骤3-6综合判读。
body.en: Note: risk points are schematic, not fixed patterns; interpret together with steps 3–6.

body.zh: •缺陷落点不一定是放电起点；
body.en: • The defect landing point need not be the discharge origin;
• Metal residue may be an arc product

body.zh: 也可能是导电搭桥证据。
body.en: or evidence of a conductive bridge.

body.zh: 易误判情形（不应仅凭外观直接判为Arc）
body.en: Potential misclassification (appearance alone does not prove an arc)

body.zh: 量测反馈：Optical / SEM / EDS / Defect Map / Electrical
body.en: Measurement feedback: optical / SEM / EDS / defect map / electrical

body.zh: 决定Wafer disposition、受影响Die范围与腔体交叉污染风险
body.en: Determines wafer disposition, affected die scope and chamber cross-contamination risk

body.zh: • 受影响Die标记、报废或补测策略
body.en: • Mark affected die, scrap or additional-test strategy

body.zh: •腔体工艺与材料残留评估、清洁验证与预防措施
body.en: • Assess chamber process and material residues; verify cleaning and prevention

body.zh: 边界注记：低能量或短时Arc不一定留下肉眼可见痕迹，需依赖多手段证据链综合判断。
body.en: Boundary: low-energy or brief arcs may leave no visible marks; combine multiple evidence sources.
